pages.items: Track the company's internal supplies and materials, separate from customer merchandise.
pages.receipts: Record supplies received into a warehouse. Drafts change stock only after they are posted.
pages.dispatches: Transfer supplies from a warehouse to an employee, vehicle or crew. Posting moves the stock; dispatches record no revenue.
pages.recipients: Maintain destinations used when sending company supplies out of stock.
pages.suppliers: Maintain suppliers used when receiving company supplies into stock.

validation.quantityRequired: Quantity must be a whole number greater than zero.
validation.priceInvalid: Enter a USD price with at most two decimals.
validation.reorderInvalid: Reorder threshold must be a whole number of 0 or more.

form.readOnlyStockHint: Stock comes from posted ledger movements across all holders.

workflow.itemHint: Name the internal supply or material so staff can find it in receipts and dispatches.
workflow.reorderHint: Set the stock level at which this item needs reordering.
workflow.receiptHint: Add one line per supply received with its quantity and cost per unit.
workflow.dispatchHint: Add one line per supply leaving the warehouse. Available quantities come from the source warehouse.
workflow.supplierHint: Choose who supplied these items and the date they were received.
workflow.recipientHint: Confirm the dispatch date, then choose the employee or daily route receiving the supplies.
workflow.costHint: Cost per unit for this receipt.
workflow.incomeHint: Total income from this dispatch, if any.
workflow.availableHint: Current stock balance before saving this dispatch.
workflow.supplierDetailsHint: Use the supplier’s company name so staff can find it when recording a receipt.
workflow.contactsDetailsHint: Add the people to contact for orders or questions.
workflow.addressesDetailsHint: Search for the supplier’s address or enter it manually.
workflow.phonesDetailsHint: Add contact numbers and use the star to choose the main number.
workflow.emailsDetailsHint: Add email addresses for supplier correspondence.
workflow.receiptDraftHint: Saved as a draft. Stock and valuation change only when the receipt is posted.
workflow.dispatchDraftHint: Saved as a draft. Posting moves stock from the warehouse to the destination holder; dispatches record no revenue.
workflow.holderHint: Stock always belongs to a persistent holder: a warehouse, employee, vehicle or route crew.
workflow.priceHint: Used as the suggested price for supply sales.
workflow.adjustmentHint: Corrects a holder's ledger balance. The adjustment is posted immediately and cannot be edited.
workflow.readOnlyPosted: Posted and cancelled documents are read-only. Record a correcting document instead.

delete.itemsDescription: This will permanently remove {{count}} selected items from the catalog.
delete.itemDescription: This will permanently remove {{name}} from the catalog.
delete.recipientsDescription: This will permanently remove {{count}} selected recipients.
delete.suppliersDescription: This will permanently remove {{count}} selected suppliers.
delete.supplierDescription: This will permanently remove {{name}} from suppliers.

errors.insufficientStock: Insufficient stock for one or more line items.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
errors.adjustmentsUnavailable: Stock adjustments are not available yet. Record a receipt or dispatch instead.

receipt.postDescription: Posting the receipt from {{name}} adds its lines to warehouse stock and valuation. Posted receipts cannot be edited.
receipt.cancelDescription: The draft receipt from {{name}} will be cancelled. Stock is not affected.

dispatch.postDescription: Posting moves the dispatched lines from the source warehouse to {{name}}. Posted dispatches cannot be edited.
dispatch.cancelDescription: The draft dispatch to {{name}} will be cancelled. Stock is not affected.

items.deactivateOne: {{name}} will be hidden from new receipts and dispatches. Its history and stock are kept.
items.deactivateMany: {{count}} items will be hidden from new receipts and dispatches. Their history and stock are kept.
items.reactivateOne: {{name}} will be available again for receipts and dispatches.
items.reactivateMany: {{count}} items will be available again for receipts and dispatches.

suppliers.deactivateOne: {{name}} will be hidden from new receipts. Its receipt history is kept.
suppliers.deactivateMany: {{count}} suppliers will be hidden from new receipts. Their receipt history is kept.
suppliers.reactivateOne: {{name}} will be available again for receipts.
suppliers.reactivateMany: {{count}} suppliers will be available again for receipts.

toasts.dispatchPosted: Dispatch posted. Stock moved to the destination holder.

holders.label: Holders
holders.description: Stock stays with its persistent holder overnight. Daily routes are context only.

items.label: Supply catalog
items.description: Catalog and effective-dated prices. Quantities come from the inventory ledger.

stock.label: Stock balances
stock.description: Read-only balances per item, holder and condition.

receipts.label: Receiving
receipts.description: Receive purchased supplies into a warehouse. Posting increases stock and valuation.

dispatches.label: Dispatches
dispatches.description: Transfer supplies from a warehouse to an employee, vehicle or persistent crew. Dispatch does not record revenue.

returns.label: Returns
returns.description: Return some or all supplies to a warehouse. To move stock between employees, return first, then dispatch.

dispositions.label: Loss & damage
dispositions.description: Classify missing, lost, stolen or damaged supplies. Quarantine remains company-owned. Sales are recorded separately.

counts.label: Physical counts
counts.description: Submit a physical snapshot. A count never silently adjusts inventory.

adjustments.label: Adjustments
adjustments.description: Authorized ledger corrections require a reason. Posted movements are immutable.

sales-reports.label: Supply sales
sales-reports.description: Daily aggregate supply sales. Posting deducts stock once; collection and handover are separate.

payments.label: Collections
payments.description: Record each tender separately for mixed payments. Collected funds are not automatically received by the office.

cash-handovers.label: Office handovers
cash-handovers.description: Transfer custody of verified cash or checks. The receiver must acknowledge receipt.

collection-obligations.label: Outstanding obligations
collection-obligations.description: Unpaid sales and unremitted collections carry forward until settled. Settlement does not create revenue.

closeouts.label: Daily closeouts
closeouts.description: Count available and quarantined stock. Classify physical differences before closing and explain financial differences. Retained stock carries forward.

route-crews.label: Persistent crews
route-crews.description: Persistent crews can own stock through a holder. Membership is effective-dated.

daily-routes.label: Daily route context
daily-routes.description: Dated schedule only; never an inventory destination. One route per employee per business date.

reports/stock-valuation.label: Stock valuation
reports/stock-valuation.description: Quantity and carrying value per holder, item and condition.

reports/sales.label: Sales summary
reports/sales.description: Supply quantity sold and revenue per holder, item and date.

reports/obligations.label: Obligations summary
reports/obligations.description: Outstanding and settled amounts per obligation.

reports/discrepancies.label: Count discrepancies
reports/discrepancies.description: Expected versus counted quantities from physical counts.

journal-entries.label: Journal entries
journal-entries.description: Accounting entries linked to their source documents.

commandHints.post: Posting writes this document to the inventory ledger. Posted documents cannot be edited.
commandHints.cancel: Cancelling the draft keeps it for reference without changing stock.
commandHints.submit: Submits the counted lines as a snapshot. It does not adjust stock.
commandHints.verify: Marks the payment as verified so it can be handed over and allocated.
commandHints.void: Voids the payment. Its allocations must be released first.
commandHints.receive: Confirms that you received this cash or check handover.

operations.title: Supply operations
operations.subtitle: Warehouse → accountable holder → sales, returns and daily closeout
operations.disabled: Supply operations is not available for this deployment.
operations.noAccess: Your account has no access to supply operations.
operations.reviewHint: Review before confirming. Posted transactions cannot be edited.
operations.priceGroupsHint: Actual price groups (must match quantity sold and revenue)

errors.versionRequired: Reload this record to get its current version, then try again.
errors.listContract: The API returned an unexpected list response.
errors.requestFailed: Request failed. Retry after checking your connection.

validation.money: Enter a USD amount with at most two decimals.
validation.instant: Enter a valid date and time.
validation.damageResolution: Choose quarantine or write-off for damaged lines.
validation.priceGroups: Price groups must match quantity sold and actual revenue.
validation.positiveAmount: Amount must be greater than zero.
validation.settlementSource: Choose exactly one verified payment or received handover.
validation.holderEntity: An employee, vehicle or crew is required.

closeout.previewHint: Post sales, returns and classified losses before closing. Retained stock stays with this holder.
closeout.bothCountsRequired: Enter both available and quarantined counts for every item, including zero.
closeout.previewIncomplete: The server preview is incomplete. Refresh before closing.
closeout.countEveryItem: Count every item, including quarantined stock.
closeout.classifyDifferences: Classify physical differences through posted dispositions or adjustments, then refresh.
closeout.unexpectedStock: Post an adjustment for unexpectedly found stock before closing.
closeout.explainDifference: Explain the financial difference before closing.
closeout.reconciled: Counts reconcile with the preview. Confirm to create an immutable revision. Sales and returns are not posted again.
closeout.readOnly: Read-only reconciliation. Closing requires closeout permission.
